note: Renew disclosure for #6336 Bound item 5 (one candidate tree): verify:class-checks and verify:evaluator-surface --base-ref now take their file set from the working tree against the merge base of the base ref and HEAD, plus untracked files. A committed change that is reverted in the working tree nets out, and base-only commits no longer enter the evaluator-surface set (it used a two-dot base..HEAD diff). On a clean committed tip the set equals CI's <base>...HEAD, so CI verdicts do not change. No merge base falls back to the base ref. Disclosure only; not #3164 authorization. Refs #6336.
